Overview

Wilmington is a city in NC with a population of 115,451. Port city with Riverwalk, film production, and coastal Carolina charm. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
